cases.why: an opened override pull request raises nothing, so the week locks without anyone being told it is waiting -- weeks 7 and 8 again
a merged pull request leaves its issue open, so the alert outlives its cause and teaches people to ignore it
the watch matches a file name the lock does not read, so it stays quiet about exactly the file that matters
a merge is reported as a close without merging, telling Mark his overrides will not be used when they will
cases.find:
if merged:
        return f'#{pr} was merged

if not merged:
        return f'#{pr} was merged
